title: Configuration grids and bounds
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for declarative multi-dimensional configuration grids, runtime parameter clamping, verified cell lifecycles, contextual regime selection, saturated boundary auto-expansion and AST magic-literal gates.
boundaries: Promoting a configuration cell requires an independent verifier whose worker_id and key_id both differ from the proposer; unverified cells never promote.
Boundary auto-expansion proposes a next-generation NodeGrid spec noun rather than mutating running production configs.
ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate parses Python ASTs statically and never imports or executes untrusted code.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for multi-dimensional configuration grids, verified cell lifecycles, boundary auto-expansion and zero-magic-literal AST gates

value.lets_workers: Replace hardcoded magic constants with externalized multi-dimensional NodeGrid specifications, clamp runtime inputs with ParameterBounds, advance cells through GridLedger only after independent verification, resolve optimal cells per workload regime via OperationCostLedger, expand saturated range endpoints into a new grid generation and enforce zero hardcoded numbers mechanically with ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate.

flow.when: Declare tunable choice, integer_range, float_range and boolean axes with cross-parameter constraints, clamp runtime inputs and enumerate applicable cells.
Scan operational Python functions and classes via AST to reject inline numeric magic literals beyond canonical mathematical identities.
Independently verify evaluated cell metrics, promote the cell for its workload regime and auto-expand saturated grid boundaries into generation+1.

value.worked_example: Synthetic 4-axis context-shim and retrieval tuning grid recomputed in test_config_grids.py: enumerates 72 represented cells and 48 applicable cells under the deletes-require-cuckoo constraint, blocks proposer self-verification (409), promotes a distinct-verifier cell, resolves verified_ledger_optimum for mutable_spider_frontier, expands saturated shim_max_chars (2400->4800) and probe_radius_bits (2->4) into generation 2, passes clean AST code and flags inline magic literal 1800.

nouns.title: Guardrail: configuration cells cannot skip lifecycle states or promote without a distinct verifier
nouns.category_reason: Prevents unverified tuning cells or single-worker self-approvals from entering regime selection.

value.rule: Every cell progresses sequentially through represented -> applicable -> proposed -> dispatched -> evaluated -> verified -> promoted, and transitioning to verified requires worker_id and key_id distinct from the proposer.
value.how_it_is_checked: GridLedger.transition returns status_code 409 on lifecycle skips, constraint-violating cells or matching proposer/verifier identities.

nouns.title: Guardrail: operational functions and classes forbid inline magic numeric scalars
nouns.category_reason: Forces behavioral thresholds, capacities, timeouts and budgets into externalized configuration grids.

value.rule: Only canonical mathematical identities (-1, 0, 1, -1.0, 0.0, 1.0, booleans) may appear inline inside operational Python callables; all other numeric scalars fail AST verification.
value.how_it_is_checked: ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate.scan_paths parses ASTs statically and reports file, line, column and offending literal.

nouns.title: Specification: NodeGrid axis types, 7-state GridLedger lifecycle and AST identity allowlist
nouns.category_reason: Defines deterministic bounds clamping, lifecycle state transitions and AST conformance criteria.

nouns.title: Contextual workload-regime cell lookup and saturated-axis boundary auto-expansion rule
nouns.category_reason: Zero-model procedure choosing verified lowest-cost cells per regime and expanding ceilings when empirical optima hit range endpoints.

value.boundary_expansion_rule: When a verified optimum equals high, multiply high by expansion_factor and increment generation; when it equals positive low, divide low by expansion_factor.

nouns.title: Tool card: standard-library NodeGrid, GridLedger, OperationCostLedger and ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate
nouns.category_reason: Tested Python 3.10+ standard-library package pinned by path and SHA-256.

value.name: configuration grids and bounds
value.runtime: Python 3.10 or later, standard library only.
does: Clamps runtime parameters via ParameterBounds and enumerates represented vs constraint-applicable NodeGrid cells.
Enforces 7-step GridLedger cell progression with distinct-verifier 409 checks and contextual OperationCostLedger regime selection.
Expands saturated range boundaries into generation+1 and scans Python ASTs via ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate.
does_not: Execute scanned source code, mutate live deployed workers directly or promote unverified cells.

slots.name: grid_declaration
slots.description: Pin of externalized JSON grid axis and constraint specification.

steps: Parse choice, integer_range, float_range and boolean axes into ParameterBounds.
Enumerate Cartesian cells and filter constraint-violating combinations.

verbs.title: Scan operational Python ASTs to reject hardcoded non-identity numeric literals
verbs.summary: Parse Python source ASTs statically and fail closed if any numeric scalar outside (-1, 0, 1, -1.0, 0.0, 1.0) appears inside operational functions or methods.
verbs.outcome: Deterministic AST conformance verdict with file, line and column diagnostics.

slots.name: target_code_noun
slots.description: Pin of Python source files governed by configuration grids.

steps: Parse Python ASTs without importing or executing modules.
Flag any non-identity integer or float constant inside FunctionDef or AsyncFunctionDef bodies.

acceptance.check: ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate passes clean grid-injected code and flags hardcoded numeric caps.

verbs.title: Independently verify evaluated cell metrics, promote regime optimum and auto-expand saturated bounds
verbs.summary: Verify evaluated GridLedger metrics with a distinct reviewer, promote the cell into OperationCostLedger for its workload regime and emit a generation+1 NodeGrid when an empirical optimum hits an axis boundary.
verbs.outcome: Verified GridLedger promotion receipt and optional expanded-generation NodeGrid spec.

slots.name: evaluated_cell_bundle

steps: Reject self-verification (409) when verifier worker_id or key_id matches the proposer.
Promote independently verified cells into OperationCostLedger and expand saturated range endpoints into generation+1.

acceptance.check: Self-verification returns 409, distinct verification reaches promoted and saturated bounds increment generation.
